title: feat(setup): Setup's metadata pages open Studio's All metadata area; the catalog's Active switch moves to each item's page
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbB5em8iozkeVyx4gPsLp6Qf)_

Fixes #28578

PR 2 of 2. PR 1, #28785, retired Packaged automation's flows half and landed as `0aaad18f`. This PR carries Wanted 1, 2, 4 and 5 and the card's tests. The split is recorded in claim amendment 6561871570.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：设置里的元数据页面全部改为跳转到 Studio 的"全部元数据"区域，每条路由和旧别名都在一跳内到达，`?package`、`?scope`、`?review` 原样保留。数据源例外，仍留在设置。设置导航移除岗位、能力、权限集、声明式共享规则四项。主页移除"对象管理"侧边栏入口和"管理对象"卡片。目录的启用开关移到每个条目自己的页面上。Studio 不再链接到设置的元数据页面。旧的打包自动化书签现在跳到对应软件包的自动化栏。
- **为什么改**：ADR-0146 D1 规定设置不再有元数据编辑器和元数据目录，这些都由 Studio 的"全部元数据"区域承担。开关放在条目页面，依据的是 M-1 裁定 6554738464。
- **风险与回滚**：只有 `setup.access`、没有 `studio.access` 的管理员，今后要在 Studio 里切换这些条目，需要给他们补授 `studio.access`。changeset 里写了这一点。旧书签和外部链接会被重定向，不会失效。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/setupMetadataRedirect.ts`、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx`（`SetupMetadataRoute`、`LegacyMetadataRedirect`、`PackagedAutomationRedirect`）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/CatalogActiveSwitch.tsx`。
- **两分钟验证**：打开 `/apps/setup/metadata/position?scope=environment`，应跳到 `/studio/~all/metadata/position?scope=environment`。打开一个岗位，页面上有"启用"开关。打开 `/apps/setup/metadata/datasource`，仍停留在设置。
- **需要你做的**：确认发布说明里关于 `studio.access` 的提示是否足够。

## What changes

- **Every Setup metadata route redirects** (`@object-ui/app-shell`). All of the `/apps/<app>/metadata` routes, on both `AppContent` branches, render `SetupMetadataRoute`: the index, `_diagnostics`, `:type`, `:type/new`, `:type/:name` and `:type/:name/history`. It navigates to `setupMetadataStudioPath(rest, search, hash)`, which keeps the path below `metadata`, keeps the query, and puts the URL on the leg its query names through `areaLocationRedirect`. That leg is `?package=X` for X's leg, and `?scope=environment` or `?package=all` for `~all`. The area adds no second hop. `LegacyMetadataRedirect` (`component/metadata/{directory,resource/*}`) now goes to Studio directly. The `metadata*` rows leave `APP_ROUTE_CHUNKS`.
- **The datasource stays.** `setupMetadataStudioPath` returns `null` for `datasource…`, so those routes render the metadata-admin pages they always did. The area's own `datasource/*` route sends them back to Setup, so redirecting them would loop.
- **The console's aliases** (`@object-ui/console`). `ObjectRedirect`, `MetadataRedirect` and `SystemCatalogRedirect` call the same helper, exported from `@object-ui/app-shell`, so `system/objects`, `system/metadata` and `system/{roles,positions,permissions}` land in Studio in one hop.
- **Retired Packaged automation bookmarks** (the seat asked for this after #28785). `component/automation/packaged` is a static route ahead of `component/:ns/:name`. It opens `/studio/<package>/automations` with the query kept when `?package=` names a package. When no package is named, it opens `/studio/~all/metadata/flow`, the area's cross-package flow list, because the pillar is per package.
- **The review hop.** `DraftReviewNavigator` (the chat's "Review N changes") opens `…/metadata/<type>/<name>?review=1` in Studio.
- **Nav and Home.** `plugin-security` drops its `group_access_control` contribution (`nav_positions`, `nav_capabilities`, `nav_permission_sets`), and `plugin-sharing` drops `nav_declared_sharing_rules`. Their labels leave the four locales and the source-hash files, and the four ids join the dead-key tombstone. `UnifiedSidebar` drops `sys-objects`, and `QuickActions` drops the Manage Objects card.
- **The Active switch moves to the item's page** (M-1 ruling A, comment 6554738464). The list's switch, its confirm dialog and its ledger cell move into `CatalogActiveSwitch.tsx`. `CatalogItemActiveSwitch` is that switch for one item: it reads the ledger, runs the holder-count confirm for permission sets and positions, writes, and toasts. The area's item pages mount it: position and sharing rule through `ResourceEditPage`'s area sections, and permission set through `PermissionMatrixEditor`. The area's list keeps its column.
- **Studio stops linking into Setup.** `BuilderLanding` drops `overlayPath` and the "Open in Setup" overlay link, along with its two Studio-namespace strings. `StudioReadOnlyLink` links the item's page in the area.
- **Live specs** (`ui/e2e/live`). `studio-object-designer`, `studio-editor` and the nightly `declared-sharing-rules-reach-13091` now open Studio URLs.

## Why

ADR-0146 D1 says Setup carries no metadata editor and no metadata catalog, and Studio's "All metadata" area (#28561) serves those pages. Old Setup links should land there rather than break. The datasource is runtime configuration, so it stays in Setup.

## Tests

- New `AppContent.setupMetadataStudio-28578.test.tsx` holds the redirect table over every route and alias. It runs on the with-app branch (as `setup` and as `crm`) and the zero-app branch. Every row asserts the whole chain, which shows one hop. The table covers `?package`, `?scope`, `?review` and the hash. It checks that the datasource routes and the `?type=datasource` alias stay on their pages, and that `metadata/package/*` keeps its target. It pins the Packaged automation bookmark, with a control that `automation:packaged-actions` still resolves.
- New `setupMetadataRedirect.test.ts` covers the helper. It includes a check that each target is already on its leg, so the area adds no second hop, and it covers `packagedAutomationStudioPath`.
- New `noSetupMetadataLink-28578.test.ts` is the source grep pin. It reads every non-test file under `views/studio-design/` with comments masked and refuses any `/apps/<app>/metadata` spelling. The datasource is exempt. The matcher has a control. Run against the `272fec05` copies of `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` and `BuilderLanding.tsx`, it catches the base's links.
- New `CatalogActiveSwitch.itemPage-28578.test.tsx` checks the switch for each type. Off asks with the holder count, Cancel writes nothing, and on writes at once. A sharing rule writes with no holder read. A viewer who cannot author gets no click, and a refused read is stated in words. A source pin checks where the item pages mount the switch.
- Inverted nav pins:
  - `people-org-assignment-nav-contribution.test.ts`: the catalog entries are gone;
  - `systemNavObjectsHop.test.tsx`: there is no Object Manager entry;
  - `systemNavSettingsTarget.test.tsx`: eight entries;
  - `QuickActions.settingsTarget.test.tsx`: there is no Manage Objects card.
- The extended tombstone has four ids.
- Route tests are re-pointed at Studio: `pseudoRouteSegments`, `noAppComponentRoutes`, `bootRedirectCoverage`, `emptyNavigationLanding-12079`, `setupItemRoutesVerdict-12706`, and the console's `legacyRedirects` and `systemHubRoutes`. Studio tests are updated for the removed link: `readonlyRoutes-11808`, `setupExit-12513`, `environmentOverlayCopy-12171`, `StudioReadOnlyLink.overlay-27356` and `metadataAreaHost.gates-28561`.

## Verification

Head `50d583ef` on `0aaad18f`.

- ui: 332 test files in two locked batches (`--maxWorkers=2`) on the rebased head, 3594 tests, all green. The set is every app-shell and console test that names the touched modules or a Setup metadata URL (`AppContent`, `setupMetadataRedirect`, `UnifiedSidebar`, `QuickActions`, `BuilderLanding`, `StudioReadOnlyLink`, `CatalogActiveSwitch`, `ResourceListPage`, `ResourceEditPage`, `PermissionMatrixEditor`, `catalog-activation`, `apps/setup/metadata`, `automation/packaged`, …). The full app-shell suite is left to CI's Test UI shards.
- `@objectstack/platform-objects`: 107 files and 1497 tests. `@objectstack/plugin-security`: 238 files and 5126 tests. `@objectstack/plugin-sharing`: 59 files and 1305 tests. All green.
- Type-check: `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/console` are green after `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/console^...'` on the new main.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 67 commands, 66 exit 0, including `check-sdui-manifest`, `check:i18n` (bundles in sync), `check:platform-checklist`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` exits 3 because this clone is shallow, so it is left to CI.
- `eslint` on the changed ui files: 0 errors.
- PR-body gates on this body: `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-closing-keyword-parity` and `check-partof-closing-keyword` are green.
